adopt: Resolve an.aither keyword, or check an entry's evidence-based trust tier, offline.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Anyone can stand up a polished site, company and pile of reviews in an afternoon; a directory that ranks on looks is gamed first, and an agent has no way to tell.

Install
pip install awindex

Commands
  awindex

Quick start
  pip install awindex
  awindex resolve neocities # route + trust tier; exit 1 = not indexed
  awindex search "digital garden"
  awindex show neocities.org
  awindex --root records check # validate a checkout of the index repo
synopsis: A curated, git-backed map of the internet
